label: unstated
reason: The docstring only says code is replaced by -CODE-, but the test expects a `<code>` tag outside `<pre>` to stay as plain text, and a period to be appended to a paragraph with no trailing punctuation.
missing: The docstring should say that only `<pre>` and `<blockquote>` blocks are replaced by -CODE- (a standalone `<code>` tag is kept as text) and that paragraphs not ending in punctuation get a period appended (or a colon if a code block follows), with no newline inserted between adjacent elements.
